description.value: Torchlight Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and full-service taproom lounge in downtown Nelson, BC, co-founded in 2014 by two friends who scaled from a nano-brewery to a proper micro-brewery with a full lounge by 2017. Nelson is one of BC's premier cycling destinations and the brewery is a partner with Nelson and Kootenay Lake Tourism. Touring cyclists stopping in town will find house-crafted beers alongside a full food menu in a welcoming brewpub setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms an active brewpub at 125 Hall Street, Nelson, BC, with a phone number matching OSM (+1-250-352-0094). The site describes a full-service lounge with food and beer menus, and lists a partnership with Nelson and Kootenay Lake Tourism, but makes no mention of bike-specific amenities (racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.), so those are left null per evidence-only rules. OSM opening_hours differ from the hours shown on the website, which is flagged as a concern.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established craft brewery and lounge in the heart of a major BC cycling hub, with an active website and food menu. Suitable for the directory; on-site verification of bike parking and cyclist-specific amenities is recommended to complete the listing.
